basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Project Technical Support I Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The Department of CM&FM at AIIMS Bhubaneswar has invited applications for one temporary contractual Project Technical Support -I (Data Entry Operator, IT domain with experience) post under the project "An implementation research study on developing a high-quality patient- centric integrated model for emergency care systems in selected districts of India", under Dr Arvind Kumar Singh, Additional Professor. The pay is Rs.19,800 per month (Rs.18,000 + Rs.1,800 [10% HRA]), the tenure is up to 31 December 2026, and the essential qualification is 10th + Diploma/12th with two years' experience in rel

how_to_apply: The notice asks for no application before the interview day. Candidates appear at the walk-in interview on the date given, with the documents named below. Queries: 9348166107 (Aftab).

Fill in the application form given on pages 4 to 7 of the notice. It asks for personal details, educational qualification, current activities, experience, two referees, a photograph and a declaration.
Report on 16 November 2026 (Monday) between 10 AM and 11 AM at Room No- 317, 3rd Floor, CM & FM Department, Academic Building, AIIMS Bhubaneswar.
Submit a separate application for each post.
Self-attested photocopies of certificates (degree/diploma certificates and mark sheets).
important_instructions: The position is filled purely on temporary contract basis; the contract appointee has no claim on a regular post in the institute, the Funding Agency or any Department of Government of India. Provident Fund, Pension Scheme, Leave Travel Concession and Medical claim are not admissible; an undertaking to that effect must be submitted at joining. The engagement can be terminated at any time with one month notice on either side, or forthwith by payment of one month's contractual amount. If selected, candidates must produce originals relating to educational qualifications, date of birth, experience certificates, a recent passport-size photograph, identity proof (Aadhaar/PAN/Voter ID/Driving License etc.), one set of self-attested photocopies, and the SC/ST/OBC/Disability Certificate if applicable, at joining. Candidates who fail to bring originals at joining, or whose documents show a discrepancy, will not be allowed to join and the post will be offered to waiting list candidates. Wrong or false information disqualifies the candidature at any stage; canvassing in any form is a disqualification. Any corrigendum, addendum or further information will be published on the institute website only.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bhubaneswar
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhubaneswar is a statutory body under the aegis of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Govt. of India, located at Sijua, Post-Dumduma, Bhubaneswar (Odisha) - 751019. This post is sanctioned under a research project run by the Department of CM&FM, with Dr Arvind Kumar Singh, Additional Professor, as Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: 10th + Diploma/12th with two Years' experience in relevant subject/field. Qualification and experience should be in the relevant discipline/field and from an institution of repute, and the experience should have been gained after acquiring the minimum essential qualification. Desirable: candidates with a speed test of 8000 key depressions per hour through a speed test on computer. Age limit: maximum 28 years. The cut-off date for the age limit is the date of the walk-in interview. Age relaxation is admissible for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as per government rules. Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department/Organizations are not eligible to apply. Mere fulfilling the essential/educational qualification does not guarantee selection. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The tenure is to be renewed based on satisfactory performance and availability of funds. Initial contract appointment will normally be for the period specified; further continuation or extension depends on requirement of the project, performance evaluation and approval of the competent authority, case to case. Leave applies as per Funding Agency/Institutional policy for contract staff of AIIMS BBSR.

content_sections.text: Data entry of quantitative and qualitative data, including transcripts (Odia / English) generated during interviews and focus group discussions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice asks for no application before the interview day. Candidates appear at the walk-in interview on the date given, with the documents named below. Queries: 9348166107 (Aftab). Fill in the application form given on pages 4 to 7 of the notice. It asks for personal details, educational qualification, current activities, experience, two referees, a photograph and a declaration. Report on 16 November 2026 (Monday) between 10 AM and 11 AM at Room No- 317, 3rd Floor, CM & FM Department, Academic Building, AIIMS Bhubaneswar. Submit a separate application for each post. Duly filled-in application form. Original documents. Self-attested photocopies of certificates (degree/diploma certificates and mark sheets). A passport-size photograph.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The interview is conducted in offline mode only. Engagement of the applicant for the position will be decided by the selection committee/appointing authority. The institute reserves the right to consider or reject any application, and the decision of the Director, AIIMS BBSR is final and binding. The institute may cancel or modify the recruitment process at any time at its discretion.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy, for Project Technical Support -I (Data Entry Operator, IT domain with experience).

faq.question: Q2. When is the AIIMS Bhubaneswar walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The tentative date is 16 November 2026 (Monday), with reporting from 10 AM to 11 AM at Room No- 317, 3rd Floor, CM & FM Department, Academic Building, AIIMS Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is 10th + Diploma/12th with two Years' experience in relevant subject/field. A speed test of 8000 key depressions per hour on computer is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 28 years, counted on the date of the walk-in interview. Age relaxation is admissible for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Technical Support -I?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs.19,800 per month (Rs.18,000 + Rs.1,800 [10% HRA]), with a 5% increment on initial emoluments after two years.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of Rs.19,800?
faq.answer: No. The notice prints Rs.19,800 as Rs.18,000 plus Rs.1,800 (10% HRA), so the HRA is included in that figure.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for this AIIMS Bhubaneswar post?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form attached to the notice and bring it with original documents, self-attested photocopies and a passport-size photograph to the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a purely temporary contract post up to 31 December 2026, to be renewed based on satisfactory performance and availability of funds, with no claim on a regular post.

faq.question: Q9. Who is not eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department/Organizations are not eligible.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the post located?
faq.answer: The place of posting is Puri, Odisha.
